title: 睡美人
description: 經典童話，睡美人的故事

sentences.en: A king and queen had a beautiful baby girl.
sentences.zh: 國王和王后有一個美麗的寶寶女孩。

sentences.en: They invited all the fairies to the party.
sentences.zh: 他們邀請了所有仙女參加派對。

sentences.en: One evil fairy was not invited.
sentences.zh: 一個邪惡的仙女沒有被邀請。

sentences.en: The evil fairy put a curse on the baby.
sentences.zh: 邪惡的仙女對嬰兒下了詛咒。

sentences.en: The baby would prick her finger and die.
A good fairy changed the curse to sleep.
sentences.zh: 一個好仙女把詛咒改成睡眠。

sentences.en: The princess slept for a hundred years.
A prince came to wake her up.
They got married and lived happily.
sentences.zh: 他們結婚並幸福地生活。
